summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima (YPF) filed a Form 6-K as a foreign private issuer, reporting the closing of a portfolio optimization transaction disclosed in February 2026. It assigned its 100% conventional exploitation concession in the Manantiales Behr area (Chubut) and associated hydrocarbon transportation concession to Assignees: Pecom Servicios Energía S.A.U. (51%) and San Benito Upstream S.A.U. (49%). The transaction also includes sale of inventory at Manantiales Behr and Km 20 warehouses. All conditions precedent, including governmental authorizations, were fulfilled. The divestiture aligns with YPF's 4x4 Plan focusing on unconventional fields. No price or consideration was disclosed. What to watch: further details on proceeds and buyer identity for strategic clarity.
